svg.title: SportFieldBookingApp - sports field booking system: Android app and PHP backend
svg.desc: SportFieldBookingApp, case study 03. A sports field booking system in two public repositories: an Android app and a PHP backend (REST API). Vietnamese repository description: hệ thống đặt sân tập (sports facility booking system). Android app, built with Java, Android and Firebase: in-app chat with delivered and seen status, one-to-one voice and video calls via ZegoCloud, Firebase sign-in and push notifications. PHP backend with MySQL: REST API modules for bookings, fields, payments via VNPay, reviews and teammates, plus a web admin panel; JWT authentication. Repositories: SportFieldBookingApp (the Android app) and htdocs (the PHP backend).
